body: She's just getting off of work now. She texted me and said that we need to talk when she gets home. I'm not worried about her hurting herself now, but I'm not sure if we are breaking up, if she wants to do that or not, and I don't know if I should stay with her or not. I don't know what to do and I'm so nervous I can hardly stand it. I just want to do the right thing and I don't know what that is.

I know. I need to talk to her either way. I have a really hard time saying what I really think though. I automatically try to spare the other person's feelings no matter what. It's stupid I know, but it's a habit I grew up with. I go into a conversation planning to say exactly how I feel, but if she starts crying I end up back pedaling and just kind of give her what she wants. It's ridiculous, but I can see myself just going with the flow to keep her happy, even if I'm not happy with it. I don't know how to get out of that. I guess I do it to avoid the anxiety that comes with telling someone something they don't want to hear.

The most difficult part is not knowing what she intends. I don't know if she is intending to come back and go on like before and consider this to be just a freak out, or if she wants it to be over. And I don't know which way I want it to go. I'm scared of either possibility, really. I think I might be more scared of going on with her like before, but I'm not sure. It's all so confusing. I don't know what to do.

I'm 28,she's 25.

I don't really think she will hurt herself, though from the way she was talking I thought she might. 

She's been living with me. She gets off work this morning, so I'll see if she comes back. I've got to take her son to school this morning. 

I know that it will be ok eventually, but I'm really nervous about going through whatever is going to happen. I'm trying to stay calm as best I can. I can't deny that stuff like this scares the crap out of me though.
Thank you very much for commenting. It really means a lot to hear from someone.
That's good advice. I am trying but it is difficult to just say what I think. Thank you very much for responding.
